nature: qualification ledger definitions and existing-record samples only; no new registered factor or implemented merger adapter

field_definitions.sourcehash: SHA-256 of exact existing file bytes, not evidence the source is accurate
field_definitions.period_or_trade_date: Date the market observation describes; not vendor arrival time
field_definitions.factor_operating_date: Provider dividOperateDate; event purpose/announcement still unknown
field_definitions.published_at: Original public version timestamp; unknown remainsnull
field_definitions.available_at: Actually available through the declared data path at a historical decision; unknown remainsnull
field_definitions.retrieved_at: Saved actual2026 retrieval timestamp; never substitute for historic availability
field_definitions.scale_policy_id: Frozen policy identity required before price transformation; proposed/null means not adopted
field_definitions.scale_reference_date: Verified per-security adjustment reference; not inferred from file last date or mtime
field_definitions.instrument_id: Permanent security identity, currently unresolved; six-digit symbol alone insufficient for rename/merger
field_definitions.effective_from/effective_to: Official effective interval for membership or identity; not interval-probe change date
field_definitions.terminal_rights: Verified lawful cash or successor security entitlement with effective/payment dates; does not default to0
field_definitions.claim_scope: retrospective declared snapshot, publicly-known-at-time, vendor-known-at-time or executable trading, assessed independently

proof_boundary: null/false record is a missing-evidence declaration, not successful validation or permission to query
